finding.mechanism: The SFT generator emits cognition calls that were not defined in one closed ClayCode Cognition v1 intrinsic vocabulary, while the spec states unknown intrinsic and bad arity fail closed. The original structural validator did not check call vocabulary/arity and OOD scoring reused it.
finding.risk: Training or OOD promotion could credit targets that look structurally ClayCode-like yet are undefined under the claimed deterministic admission contract.

delta: intrinsics_v1.py defines one machine-readable cognition intrinsic vocabulary and arity map
validate_sft_v1.py rejects unknown calls and wrong arity in addition to existing envelope/omega gates
string payload masking preserves one passive argument token so literal arguments retain arity without allowing literal punctuation to alter syntax
CLAYCODE_COGNITION_V1.md now explicitly binds the same closed-vocabulary law
audit_intrinsic_closure_v1.py deterministically audits all generated SFT targets without executing actions
automatic_training_gate: The existing Together launcher on fused main already invokes validate_sft_v1.py for train and validation before upload; once this validator delta is merged, undefined/wrong-arity intrinsics fail before remote upload while main's fingerprint/idempotency create protections remain unchanged.

unusual_experiment.result: First lexer revision was falsified because complete string masking made cfg(string) appear arity zero. Repair preserves a passive literal placeholder. Representative valid calls then matched arity; injected unknown and wrong-arity calls were rejected.
